checks.name: Controller Failure Resilience
checks.details: Existing capacity continues operating if the autoscaler controller crashes

checks.name: Worker Creation Retry Handling
checks.details: Worker spawn failures retried automatically with backoff

checks.name: Ceiling Limit Backpressure & Graceful Degradation
checks.details: System survives queue saturation at max replica ceiling (80 workers) without crashing

checks.name: Cloud Capacity Alert & Fallback
checks.details: Cloud quota exhaustion triggers immediate alert and secondary pool activation

failure_scenarios.description: Controller process killed during active queue spike
failure_scenarios.expected_behavior: Existing worker pool continues processing without disruption
failure_scenarios.actual_behavior: All 10 existing workers remained active and processed 100% of backlog; controller restarted in 3s

failure_scenarios.description: Docker/K8s API temporarily throttles pod creation
failure_scenarios.expected_behavior: Autoscaler retries with exponential backoff; no jobs dropped
failure_scenarios.actual_behavior: Retried after 5s; 5 new workers spawned successfully on second attempt

failure_scenarios.failure_type: Infrastructure Hard Capacity Limit Reached (Max Replicas 80)
failure_scenarios.description: Queue surges to 50,000 jobs exceeding 80-worker maximum ceiling
failure_scenarios.expected_behavior: Workers capped at 80; graceful backpressure / rate limiting activated without OOM
failure_scenarios.actual_behavior: Worker pool held at 80; queue backlog drained over 12 minutes without worker crash

failure_scenarios.expected_behavior: Alert fired to SRE channel; fallback to secondary spot/on-demand pool
failure_scenarios.actual_behavior: Alert dispatched; fallback pool activated within 15 seconds
